पिचुः [पच्-उ पृषो˚ Tv.]
—1 Cotton.
—2 A kind of weight, a Karśa (equal to two tolas).
—3 A kind of leprosy.
—4 A kind of grain.

 Dk. 2. 3; सार्धं कथंचिदुचितैः पिचुमर्दपत्रैः Śi. 5. 66.

पिचुकः N. of a plant; Vangueria Spinosa (Mar. तगर ?).

—1 Cotton.
—2 A kind of cormorant or sea-crow.
पिच्च् €10 U. (पिच्चयति-ते) To cut, divide.
पिच्चट a. Pressed flat.
पिच्चट + .{@-टः@} Inflammation of the eyes, ophthalmia.

पिच्चा A string of 16 pearls weighing a dharaṇa (a particular
 measure of pearls); Bṛ. S. 81. 17.
पिच्चिट a. Pressed flat.

पिच्छ् I. €6 P. (पिच्छति)
—1 To torment, trouble, afflict.
—2 To hinder, obstruct. ━II. €10 U. To cut, divide.

पिच्छम् [पिच्छ्-अच्]
—1 A feather of a tail (as of a peacock); Bhāg. 10. 12. 4.
—2 The tail of a peacock; शिखिपिच्छलाञ्छितकपोलभित्ती Ki. 12. 41;
 क्षणमलघुविलम्बिपिच्छदाम्नः शिखरशिखाः शिखिशेखरानमुष्य Śi. 4. 50.
—3 The feathers of an arrow.
—4 A wing.
—5 A crest.
पिच्छम् + .{@-च्छः@} A tail in general.

पिच्छम् + .{@-च्छा@}
—1 A sheath, covering, coat.
—2 The scum of boiled rice.
—3 A row, line.
—4 A heap, multitude.
—5 The gum or exudation of the silk-cotton tree.
—6 A plantain.
—7 An armour.
—8 The calf of the leg.
—9 The venomous saliva of a snake.
—10 A betel-nut. —11 A diseased affection of a horseʼs feet.
.━{@Comp.@}: पिच्छास्रावः, पिच्छबाणः, पिच्छलतिका
पिच्छम् + -आस्रावः slimy saliva.
पिच्छम् + -बाणः a hawk.
पिच्छम् + -लतिका a tail-feather.
पिच्छकः (At the end of comp.) A feather of a tail.

पिच्छ(च्छि)का The feathers of a peacockʼs tail tied in a bunch, a
 feather-brush (used by conjurors &c.).

पिच्छिल a. [पिच्छ् बा˚ इल]
—1 Slimy, lubricous, slippery, smeary; Mb. 12. 184. 34; तरुणं सर्षपशाकं
 नवौदनं पिच्छिलानि च दधीनि Chand. M. 1.
—2 Having a tail.

—3 Curds with cream on the surface.
—4 Broth, soup.
—5 Moist split pulse.
